#========================================
# Gene expression profiles across nerve categories -- Figures 2G and 3
#========================================
#
# Expression of curated gene panels across the three nerve states
# (NonInvaded_Adjacent, NonInvaded_Diseased, Invaded).
#
# For every panel, expression is averaged first within each patient and
# nerve category, then across patients for each category, and finally
# z-scored per gene. Because the z-score is taken over three values, the
# colours are relative: they show which category is highest for that
# gene, not the size of the difference.
#
# The gene panels are curated by hand. They were chosen from the GSEA
# leading-edge gene lists of the invaded-versus-non-invaded nerve
# analysis, and are written out explicitly here so that the figures do
# not depend on re-running GSEA or on a pathway-selection step.
#
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT PRODUCES
# --------------------------
# Figures (output/07_gene_expression_figures/figures/):
#   - Figure2G_heatmap.pdf
#       Figure 2G. Three immune panels (plasma/humoral, lymphoid
#       chemokine axis, T/NK cells) across the three nerve categories.
#   - Figure3_invasion_gene_heatmap.pdf
#       Invasion-associated genes, grouped by programme (nerve injury,
#       synaptic, ECM, vasculature, axon guidance, myelin debris
#       clearance, Schwann-cell niche signalling).
#   - Figure3_tumorNMF_correlated_gene_heatmap.pdf
#       Genes correlated with the tumour NMF programme.
#   - exploratory_violin_gene_groups.pdf
#       Spot-level violin plots for the wider set of curated gene
#       groups, one panel per group. NOT in the manuscript.
#   - exploratory_heatmap_gene_groups.pdf
#       The same wider set as a grouped heatmap, blocked by patient.
#       NOT in the manuscript.
#
# Anything named "exploratory_" is not in the manuscript.
#
# Tables (output/07_gene_expression_figures/tables/):
#   - Figure2G_genes.csv, Figure3_invasion_genes.csv
#       The genes actually plotted in each panel, after dropping any not
#       detected in the dataset.
#========================================

```{r}
#========================================
# 1. Load libraries and input data
#========================================
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(rlang)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(scuttle)
library(scran)
library(scater)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggsc)
```

```{r}
# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "07_gene_expression_figures"
TABLES_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "figures")
dir.create(TABLES_DIR,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

c25 <- c(
  "dodgerblue2", "#E31A1C", "green4", "#6A3D9A", "#FF7F00",
  "black", "gold1", "skyblue2", "#FB9A99", "palegreen2",
  "#CAB2D6", "#FDBF6F", "gray70", "khaki2", "maroon",
  "orchid1", "deeppink1", "blue1", "steelblue4", "darkturquoise",
  "green1", "yellow4", "yellow3", "darkorange4", "brown"
)

# ---- Frozen inputs: never recomputed here ------------------------------
spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "DE_SPE_annotaion.csv")))
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode
```

```{r}
#========================================
# 2. Subset nerve spots and define nerve categories
#========================================
nerve_spe <- spe[, colData(spe)$is.nerve == TRUE]
nerve_spe$types <- nerve_spe$type
colData(nerve_spe)$types[!colData(nerve_spe)$types == "noPNI"] <- "Diseased"
colData(nerve_spe)$types[colData(nerve_spe)$types == "noPNI"] <- "Adjacent"

colData(nerve_spe)$nerve_types <- nerve_spe$Invaded
colData(nerve_spe)$nerve_types <- ifelse(
  colData(nerve_spe)$Invaded == "NonInvaded",
  paste0(colData(nerve_spe)$Invaded, "_", colData(nerve_spe)$types),
  colData(nerve_spe)$nerve_types
)
nerve_spe <- nerve_spe[, !is.na(colData(nerve_spe)$nerve_types)]

nerve_order <- c("NonInvaded_Adjacent", "NonInvaded_Diseased", "Invaded")

keep_genes <- function(x) intersect(x, rownames(nerve_spe))
```

```{r}
#========================================
# 3. Shared averaging and z-scoring
#========================================
# One function for all three heatmaps: mean per patient x nerve category,
# then mean across patients per category, then z-score per gene. The
# column order always follows nerve_order.
#
# NOTE: in an earlier version the third panel (tumour-NMF genes) took its
# column order from whatever order the categories happened to appear in
# the metadata rather than from nerve_order. The z-scores were the same;
# only the left-to-right order of the three columns could differ. All
# three panels now use nerve_order.

build_z_df <- function(gene_sets, assay_name = "logcounts") {
  gene_map <- stack(lapply(gene_sets, as.character))
  colnames(gene_map) <- c("gene", "category")
  gene_map$category <- factor(gene_map$category, levels = names(gene_sets))

  expr <- as.matrix(assay(nerve_spe, assay_name))
  meta <- as.data.frame(colData(nerve_spe))[, c("patient_id", "nerve_types")]
  meta$nerve_types <- factor(meta$nerve_types, levels = nerve_order)

  genes <- unique(gene_map$gene)
  expr  <- expr[genes, , drop = FALSE]

  # mean per patient x nerve category
  grp  <- paste(meta$patient_id, meta$nerve_types, sep = "___")
  levs <- unique(grp)
  expr_patient_type <- sapply(levs, function(g) {
    cols <- which(grp == g)
    Matrix::rowMeans(expr[, cols, drop = FALSE])
  })
  expr_patient_type <- as.matrix(expr_patient_type)
  colnames(expr_patient_type) <- levs

  # mean across patients, in nerve_order
  nerve_types_present <- sub("^.*___", "", colnames(expr_patient_type))
  nerve_order_present <- nerve_order[nerve_order %in% nerve_types_present]
  expr_type <- sapply(nerve_order_present, function(nt) {
    Matrix::rowMeans(expr_patient_type[, nerve_types_present == nt, drop = FALSE])
  })
  expr_type <- as.matrix(expr_type)
  rownames(expr_type) <- rownames(expr_patient_type)

  # z-score per gene
  expr_z <- t(scale(t(expr_type)))
  expr_z[is.na(expr_z)] <- 0

  df <- as.data.frame(expr_z) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "nerve_type", values_to = "z") %>%
    left_join(gene_map, by = "gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(category))

  gene_order <- unlist(gene_sets, use.names = FALSE)
  gene_order <- gene_order[gene_order %in% unique(df$gene)]
  df$gene       <- factor(df$gene, levels = rev(gene_order))
  df$nerve_type <- factor(df$nerve_type, levels = nerve_order_present)
  df
}

tile_heatmap <- function(df) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = nerve_type, y = gene, fill = z)) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(category), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = -1) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.spacing.y = unit(0.6, "lines"),
      strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
}
```

```{r}
#========================================
# 4. Figure 2G -- three immune panels
#========================================
# The three panels plotted in Figure 2G. The category names are the strip
# labels of the figure.

gene_sets_figure2G <- list(
  "Plasma_humoral"          = keep_genes(c("XBP1", "JCHAIN", "BCL6", "POU2F2", "IKZF1", "CD52")),
  "Lymphoid_chemokine_axis" = keep_genes(c("CCL21", "CXCL12", "CCL19", "SELL", "CCL5")),
  "Tcells/NKcells"          = keep_genes(c("CD8A", "TRAC", "ZAP70", "IL7R", "KLRK1"))
)

cat("Genes per Figure 2G panel (detected in the dataset):\n")
print(sapply(gene_sets_figure2G, length))

df_figure2G <- build_z_df(gene_sets_figure2G)

write.csv(
  df_figure2G %>% distinct(category, gene),
  file.path(TABLES_DIR, "Figure2G_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE
)

p_figure2G <- tile_heatmap(df_figure2G)
p_figure2G
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure2G_heatmap.pdf"), p_figure2G,
       width = 5, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
#========================================
# 5. Invasion-associated genes
#========================================
# A second curated panel, selected from the genes identified across the
# two invasion-related contrasts, to represent invasion-associated
# programmes: nerve injury, synaptic-like signalling, extracellular
# matrix remodelling, vasculature association, axon guidance, myelin
# debris clearance and Schwann-cell niche signalling.

gene_sets_invasion <- list(
  "Nerve_injury"            = keep_genes(c("GAP43", "GLI3", "GFRA2", "NRCAM", "NES", "SOX2")),
  "Synaptic/Glutamatergic"  = keep_genes(c("SYT11", "DLGAP1", "SYNGAP1", "SYNPO", "CNIH3")),
  "Extracellular_Matrix"    = keep_genes(c("ITGAV", "ITGA1", "DAG1", "MMP17", "MMP28", "PLOD3")),
  "Vasculature_associated"  = keep_genes(c("ESM1", "EDIL3", "VEZF1", "ENTPD1", "THSD7B")),
  "Axon_guidance"           = keep_genes(c("NAV2", "EPHB2", "UNC5C", "PLXNC1", "DRAXIN", "SEMA3C")),
  "Myelin_debris_clearance" = keep_genes(c("GAL3ST1", "SCD", "LPIN1", "AXL", "FABP5", "CLCN7")),
  "SC_niche_signaling"      = keep_genes(c("CLCF1", "CRLF1", "IL11", "CCN3", "FGF5", "BTC"))
)

df_invasion <- build_z_df(gene_sets_invasion)

write.csv(
  df_invasion %>% distinct(category, gene),
  file.path(TABLES_DIR, "Figure3_invasion_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE
)

p_invasion <- tile_heatmap(df_invasion)
p_invasion
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure3_invasion_gene_heatmap.pdf"), p_invasion,
       width = 5, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
#========================================
```
```{r}
# 7. Violin plots -- wider curated gene groups, spot level
#========================================
# A separate, wider set of gene groups, shown at spot level rather than
# as category averages. These are not the Figure 2G panels.

gene_groups <- list(
  "C3 Fibroblasts"         = c("C3", "CFH", "SPARCL1", "CXCL12", "APOD", "APOE"),
  "Lymphocyte Recruitment" = c("VCAM1", "SELL", "JAM2", "CCL21"),
  "Agprocessing"           = c("FCGR2B", "THBS1", "FGL2"),
  "B cell"                 = c("BCL6", "XBP1", "CR1"),
  "Complement"             = c("C1QA", "CFD", "C1QC", "RGCC"),
  "PGE2"                   = c("SFRP1", "PTGER4", "P2RY6"),
  "IFNgamma"               = c("STAT4", "IFIT2", "IFITM3", "SOCS3"),
  "IL6"                    = c("IL6", "OSMR", "HMOX1", "CD36"),
  "Inflammatory"           = c("CX3CL1", "C5AR1", "IL1R1", "IL10RA", "IL18R1", "CCL2", "CD14"),
  "ERK1_ERK2"              = c("CSF1R", "BRAF", "DNAJC27", "NRP1")
)

colLabels(nerve_spe) <- colData(nerve_spe)$nerve_types

make_violin_plot <- function(spe_obj, genes, plot_title, slot_name = "logcounts", ncol = 3) {
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(spe_obj))
  p <- sc_violin(spe_obj, features = genes, slot = slot_name, ncol = ncol) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    labs(title = plot_title) +
    xlab("Category") +
    ylab("Gene expression")
  facet_var <- as_name(p$facet$params$facets[[1]])
  p + facet_wrap(vars(!!sym(facet_var)), scales = "free_y")
}

violin_plots <- lapply(names(gene_groups), function(group_name) {
  make_violin_plot(
    spe_obj = nerve_spe,
    genes = gene_groups[[group_name]],
    plot_title = group_name,
    ncol = if (group_name == "C3 Fibroblasts") 2 else 3
  )
})
names(violin_plots) <- names(gene_groups)

combined_plots <- wrap_plots(violin_plots, ncol = 1)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_violin_gene_groups.pdf"), combined_plots,
       width = 16, height = 30, units = "in")
combined_plots
```

```{r}
#========================================
# 8. Grouped heatmap of the same wider set, blocked by patient
#========================================

Genes_of_interest <- unique(unlist(gene_groups))
Genes_of_interest <- Genes_of_interest[Genes_of_interest %in% rownames(nerve_spe)]

p11 <- plotGroupedHeatmap(
  nerve_spe,
  group = "nerve_types",
  features = Genes_of_interest,
  block = "patient_id",
  center = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE,
  fontsize = 14
)

p11
```
